topics.name: Memory Write Boundary
topics.purpose: Define explicit validated writes to persistent memory, separating model suggestions, transient context and accepted persisted records.

semantics.candidate_rule: Model/tool/user-produced candidate memory is inert until an explicit memory-write operation.
semantics.write_rule: Persistent write resolves exact memory scope/owner and record schema.
semantics.validation_rule: Content, source refs, classification and retention metadata validate before persistence.
semantics.authorization_rule: Memory write obeys normal AccessCore authorization.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Equivalent/same-source records follow explicit deduplication/versioning policy rather than silent overwrite.
semantics.history_rule: Updates preserve prior evidence according to lifecycle policy.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed write leaves persistent memory unchanged.
semantics.authority_rule: A model cannot persist memory solely by emitting text claiming it should be remembered.

invariants.rule: Memory and retrieved context are provenance-bearing inert data projections; remembered or retrieved content never becomes authority, canonical truth or executable instruction merely by inclusion in context.

references.purpose: Model-proposed memory writes cross normal operation boundary.
